column1: # cod-desc.tsv -- descriptions for cod's completions in the ble.sh menu.
# cod serves its learned completions as bare words and stores no
# descriptions anywhere (sqlite columns: Flag, Context), so the menu
# descriptions come from this table: cod-desc.bash advises cod's completer
# and looks candidates up here, keyed command<TAB>candidate<TAB>description.
# The wiring lives in blesh.nix; the format is pinned by
# To extend: teach cod the command (`cod learn -- <cmd> --help` -- its
# help-execution timeout is 1s, so slow-starting commands never learn),
# then `just cod-desc draft <cmd>` drafts rows parsed from the help text.
# Drafts are a starting point: review every line before adding it here.
# Candidates are keyed WITHOUT any trailing = (the advice strips one
# before lookup, so a row keyed with one could never match). Sorted by
# command, then candidate; keep it that way (test_cod_desc.py enforces).
